meta.title: Regret on an event that has been superseded by a new version
gaps: The decisive regret request cannot be expressed because no regret operation or METHOD/path and body are provided.
The plan does not verify that the new version remains unpublished.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The invited QA vendor opens a bid on the pricing round.
The buyer issues a new version of the event with the item uuid set to “…”, with the item type set to “EventGroup”.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You are not allowed to perform this action”, and never with a server error.
